note: Printable renders printer-friendly (and, via the printable_pdf submodule, PDF) versions of content entities at /{entity_type}/{entity}/printable/{format} (e.g. /node/{nid}/printable/print and /printable/pdf). All state is in the printable.settings config object, edited under /admin/config/user-interface/printable (route printable.configure). It defines two plugin types: PrintableFormat (ids print, and pdf in the submodule) and PrintableLinkExtractor (none/remove/extract/subscript). Permissions: administer printable, view printer friendly versions. Default printable entities: node, comment, user. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real printable.settings keys: introspection reads pdf_tool and paper_size; execution writes page_orientation and printable_print_link_locations. Baselines are restored explicitly (pdf_tool='', paper_size=A4, page_orientation=Portrait, printable_print_link_locations=[node]).

evals.prompt: With the printable module enabled, what are the URLs that show the printer-friendly HTML version and the PDF version of a node with id 12?
evals.expected_output: The printer-friendly page is /node/12/printable/print and the PDF is /node/12/printable/pdf (pattern /{entity_type}/{entity}/printable/{format}, route printable.show_format.node). The PDF format requires the printable_pdf submodule and a configured pdf_tool.

evals.prompt: Where is the printable module configured (route/path and config object), and which entity types get a printable version by default?
evals.expected_output: Config route printable.configure at /admin/config/user-interface/printable (with /print, /pdf, /links, /links/pdf sub-forms). All settings live in the printable.settings config object. By default printable_entities is [node, comment, user].

evals.prompt: The printable module has a pluggable system for output formats and for handling in-content links. Name the two plugin types, the shipped format plugin ids, and the link-extractor options.
evals.expected_output: PrintableFormat plugins provide output formats: 'print' (this module) and 'pdf' (printable_pdf submodule). PrintableLinkExtractor plugins rewrite in-content links, chosen via printable.settings.extract_links: none (unchanged), remove (drop href), extract (URL in brackets), subscript.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which PDF generation toolkit is currently selected for the printable module? Inspect the live configuration and answer.
evals.expected_output: TCPDF: printable.settings.pdf_tool is 'tcpdf' (read via drush cget printable.settings pdf_tool). This is the pdf_api toolkit id the printable/printable_pdf PDF format uses.

evals.prompt: What paper size is the printable module's PDF output configured to use on this site right now? Inspect the running configuration.
evals.expected_output: Letter: printable.settings.paper_size is 'Letter' (its shipped default is A4). Read via drush cget printable.settings paper_size.

evals.prompt: Configure the printable module so its generated PDFs use Landscape page orientation instead of Portrait, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set printable.settings.page_orientation to 'Landscape', e.g. drush cset printable.settings page_orientation Landscape -y (or via the PDF configuration form at /admin/config/user-interface/printable/pdf, or the config API). \Drupal::config('printable.settings')->get('page_orientation') then returns 'Landscape'.

evals.prompt: Right now the printable module only shows Print links on nodes. Configure it so the Print link also appears on comment entities, applied to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add 'comment' to printable.settings.printable_print_link_locations (e.g. set it to ['node','comment'] via the config API, or tick comment on /admin/config/user-interface/printable/links). in_array('comment', printable_print_link_locations) is then TRUE.
